en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a town with low, tile-roofed buildings lined along a wide street in the foreground. A few pedestrians walk on the street. In the background are rolling hills dotted with houses, and on the right side, a prominent neoclassical-style building with a flag on its roof stands on a small rise. Handwritten text in Greek appears at the bottom, and a web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible.
